reviews.title: Enthused about my Elegant New Nifty Nook, with my HSH Dark Gray Desk!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F1seBnDBp2L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61SW2JOn2qL._SY256.jpg Having enjoyed my 47” HSH dark gray oak desk so much over the past several years, I just purchased this additional 60” HSH dark gray oak desk to create an incredible L-Shaped workstation for my studio.
This new 60” beautiful real natural wood natural oak desk just arrived and, just the same as my first HSH desk, it was packaged perfectly so that every part of the desk is protected.  Both desks have no scratches or markings on them.
This desktop is solid wood, and the frame is a smooth black metal.  The desk is a design blend that is intriguing, both rustic and basic, yet it’s eye-catching with its gorgeous ongoing oak grain on the desktop and its unique spatial looking architecture for the desk base and legs.  We typically see in common desks the basic horizontal desktop based upon four plain downward legs. This desk is a studio with style!  The extra big desk size of this 60” is exceptionally nice for a workstation, its measuring 23.6"D x 60"W x 29.5"H.  It’s also really nice to see and feel how much leg room is available under this desk.
Assembly is so straightforward and easy that, admittedly, it’s almost a quick fun project to put this desk together.  Customer service is extraordinary, as I had one question and received right away a very comprehensive answer.  We know in today’s customer service galaxy, sometimes we’re disappointed when receiving templated answers that don’t even address our inquiry.  HSH and their customer service is a pleasant rarity – a real person with real answers.  This makes a customer want to return for more of their product offerings.
To have a unique eye-catching desk design is not only appealing, but it’s just plain fun to be there at that desk area.  This makes work seem a whole lot easier and we’re more intentional with our motivation and determination to get things done.  “Let’s go!”
As a singer/songwriter on my guitar, I find much enjoyment and comfort composing in surroundings that bring me happiness, organization, and an enticing unique corner of the world to pursue my endeavors.  My office studio, “L-Shaped Nifty Nook,” is increasingly now my happy place. It’s where many of my developments begin, and it’s like a springboard for me to new composing and design. I love to come home to this place, this space, and let creativity soar.  This desk along with my former matching like-desk has become my secluded corner where much originates and where I can engage in my work while feeling as if I’m in warm natural beauty.  It’s almost as if I’m in the forest due to my surroundings of these beautiful flowing lines of the oak grains across my desktop(s). Oak wood has always meant so much to me, representing strength, stability, and endurance.  It’s like when we choose to position ourselves around oak, we gain increased inner strength.
Indeed, I am filled with joy and happiness when sitting at my new HSH L-Shaped writing desk where I can live and love to write, develop, and allow my creative processes to take off.  This delightful desk is such a high-quality piece of furniture, exquisitely  constructed, and it’s one stunning work of art to complement any room of the home.

reviews.title: Simple and Perfect for Lots of Stuff
reviews.comment:
This desk is nice and sturdy. Plenty of surface space for my three monitor setup as well as a small desktop computer, microphone, large hard drive, audio interface, and desk organizer.
I have an office chair that sits kind of high and I like to sit close, so having a desk high enough to have the armrests under it is great.
It was easy to set up and arrived with no dings or scratches. It is light and easy to move around if needed.
It is perfect for someone who wants a simple desk to add things to themselves and not one of those fancy all in one storage desks that cost a ton and are cheaply made.
reviews.author: TJ

reviews.title: Great desk top looks like quartz
reviews.comment: This is a great deal for the money! Arrived well packaged. Easy to put together with a solid top that looks like an expensive slab of quartz! Looks great with the gold accents.
reviews.author: JP

reviews.title: Solid desk
reviews.comment: Product is as described and shown. Super simple to assemble in about 20-25 min. Clean, sleek, simple, I’m happy with the quality and functionality of it. Seems stable but I also don’t have too many heavy items on it
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.title: Simple but solid and attractive.
reviews.comment: Product came timely. Easiest furniture assembly I have done. Directions were very clear. All pieces fit as intended. Simple but solid. Extra hardware was provided  which was very thoughtful. Top is not a solid piece, but hollow. Makes it light, but strength is yet to be seen.
reviews.author: S. MacGray
